A few changes for your diary.

Firstly, our home match vs Alsager Town, originally scheduled for 14th November, will now be played on the 12th September, due to both teams exiting the FA Vase. 

Our Macron Cup 1st round tie with Bilston Town will take place on Saturday 26th September.

Before the kick off of this mornings 50th anniversary game, we honoured 2 men, who without, the club wouldn’t be where it is today. 

Over the winter, the club lost 2 people who were the heart and sole of the club. First, in December, Keith Mottershead. Motty was a huge part of the origins of Stafford Town, and played a huge role in us having this facility we have here. 

Second, in January, the club lost its chairman, Paul Beedell. Pauls fingerprints are over a lot of everything you see here today, everything from the solar panels on the roof, to the the foundations of the bar you are all drinking from. 

Today we honour both of these men. The stands many of you are now sitting in, the right side will now be known as the Keith Mottershead stand, and the left will be the Paul Beedell stand.
